data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series C–stage AI & Software company founded by Vipul Ved Prakash, Ce Zhang, Chris Ré, Tri Dao, and Percy Liang. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR) operating in the same sector and stage, including Figure AI, Skild AI, and Crusoe Energy.

Stage-progression methodology was not applied due to data integrity concerns: the reported last post-money valuation of $8.3B implies a step-up to $14.1B, which exceeds 20x the company's $530M total raised and signals a potential mis-parse in the source funding tracker. The peer-median approach was therefore the sole applicable triangulation method. Across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B)—the median valuation is $14.0B, with a range of $10.0B to $39.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $11.9B (low) to $16.1B (high), centered on a median of $14.0B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations ($10.0B–$39.0B) and reliance on a single applicable methodology. The current reported valuation of $8.3B sits below this range, suggesting either undervaluation relative to peer benchmarks or potential overstatement in the peer set itself.
